description: A security solution that mediates access between users and cloud services to enforce organizational policies and protect cloud applications and data.
An integrated security platform that protects cloud-native applications throughout their lifecycle, from development through deployment and runtime.
A cloud computing model in which a provider supplies virtualized compute, storage, and networking resources.
A cloud computing model that provides a managed environment for developing, deploying, and running applications, while the provider manages the platform resources.
A cloud computing model in which software applications are hosted and managed by a provider and accessed by customers over the internet, typically through a web browser or application.
A security approach and category of tools that continuously monitors SaaS applications for security risks, misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and compliance issues.
